title: Stitches

cues.en: I thought that I'd been hurt before, but no one's ever left me quite this sore.
cues.zh: 我以為我以前受過傷，但從來沒有人讓我這麼痛過。
cues.text: I thought that I'd been hurt before, but no one's ever left me quite this sore.

cues.en: Your words cut deeper than a knife. Now I need someone to breathe me back to life.
cues.zh: 你的話比刀子還刺人。現在我需要有人讓我重獲新生。
cues.text: Your words cut deeper than a knife. Now I need someone to breathe me back to life.

cues.en: Got a feeling that I'm going under, but I know that I'll make it out alive.
cues.zh: 我有種感覺，我快要崩潰了，但我知道我會活著出來。
cues.text: Got a feeling that I'm going under, but I know that I'll make it out alive.

cues.en: By quick calling you my lover, move on, you watch me beat it till I can breathe.
cues.zh: 快速地稱呼你為我的愛人，繼續前進，你看著我打敗它，直到我可以呼吸。
cues.text: By quick calling you my lover, move on, you watch me beat it till I can breathe.

cues.en: Shake your body down to my knees, and now that I'm with the chakises.
cues.zh: 把你的身體搖到我的膝蓋上，現在我和我在一起了。
cues.text: Shake your body down to my knees, and now that I'm with the chakises.

cues.en: I'll be needing stitches, tripping over myself, aching, begging you to come out.
cues.zh: 我需要縫針，被自己絆倒，疼痛，求你出來。
cues.text: I'll be needing stitches, tripping over myself, aching, begging you to come out.

cues.en: And now that I'm with the chakises, I'll be needing stitches.
cues.zh: 現在我已經穿上了 Chakises，我需要縫針。
cues.text: And now that I'm with the chakises, I'll be needing stitches.

cues.en: Just like a mortar onto a flame. Oh you let me in, I couldn't sense the pain.
cues.zh: 就像迫擊砲打在火焰上一樣。哦，你讓我進去，我感覺不到疼痛。
cues.text: Just like a mortar onto a flame. Oh you let me in, I couldn't sense the pain.

cues.en: You're a bitter hard coat to the tinge. Now I'm gonna reap what I sow.
cues.zh: 你是一件苦澀的硬外套。現在我要收穫我所播種的。
cues.text: You're a bitter hard coat to the tinge. Now I'm gonna reap what I sow.

cues.en: I'm left seeing red on my own. Got a feeling that I'm going under, but I know that I'll make it out alive.
cues.zh: 我獨自一人看到紅色。我有種感覺，我快要崩潰了，但我知道我會活著出來。
